description: The Tarrasch sidesteps both the Winawer's ...Bb4 pin and the Classical's ...Nf6 pressure with the flexible 3.Nd2. Black plays the closed setup with ...Nfd7 and the ...c5 break — the most popular French line at club level, leading to maneuvering battles around the pawn chain.

lines.description: After 1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5, White avoids all the sharp 3.Nc3 lines with 3.Nd2. Black develops 3...Nf6 and White closes the center with 4.e5, when Black retreats 4...Nfd7. White develops 5.Bd3 and Black strikes at the pawn chain with 5...c5. After 6.c3 Nc6, the battle revolves around the d4 pawn: White defends the chain while preparing f4, Black pressures d4 and aims for ...cxd4 or ...f6 breaks.
